124        
125        public static final float FLAG_DURATION = 0.5f;
126        
127        private class FlagData {
128                AIFlags flag;
129                float elapsed;
130                float durationOverride = 0;
131                Object custom;
132                private FlagData(AIFlags flag) {
133                        super();
134                        this.flag = flag;
135                }
136        }
137        
138
139        private Map<AIFlags, FlagData> flags = new HashMap<AIFlags, FlagData>();
140        
141        public void unsetFlag(AIFlags flag) {
142//              if (flag == AIFlags.BACK_OFF) {
143//                      System.out.println("wefwefwefe");
144//              }
145                flags.remove(flag);
146        }
147        
148        public void setFlag(AIFlags flag) {
149//              if (flag == AIFlags.BACK_OFF) {
150//                      System.out.println("fwfwefew");
151//              }
152//              if (flag == AIFlags.DO_NOT_USE_SHIELDS) {
153//                      System.out.println("fwfwefew");
154//              }
155                FlagData data = flags.get(flag);
156                if (data != null) {
157                        data.elapsed = 0;
158                } else {
159                        flags.put(flag, new FlagData(flag));
160                }
161        }
162        
163        public void setFlag(AIFlags flag, float duration) {
164                setFlag(flag, duration, null);
165        }
166        
167        public void setFlag(AIFlags flag, float duration, Object custom) {
168//              if (flag == AIFlags.DO_NOT_BACK_OFF) {
169//                      System.out.println("fwfwefew");
170//              }
171                //if (flag == AIFlags.BACK_OFF) {
172//              if (flag == AIFlags.CARRIER_FIGHTER_TARGET) {
173//                      System.out.println("fwfwefew");
174//              }
175//              if (flag == AIFlags.BACK_OFF) {
176//                      System.out.println("fwfwefew");
177//              }
178//              if (flag == AIFlags.DO_NOT_USE_SHIELDS) {
179//                      System.out.println("fwfwefew");
180//              }
181                FlagData data = flags.get(flag);
182                if (data != null) {
183                        data.elapsed = 0;
184                        data.custom = custom;
185                } else {
186                        data = new FlagData(flag);
187                        data.durationOverride = duration;
188                        data.custom = custom;
189                        flags.put(flag, data);
190                }
191        }
192        
193        public Object getCustom(AIFlags flag) {
194                FlagData data = flags.get(flag);
195                if (data != null) {
196                        return data.custom;
197                }
198                return null;
199        }
200        
201        public void removeFlag(AIFlags flag) {
202//              if (flag == AIFlags.BACK_OFF) {
203//                      System.out.println("wefwefwefe");
204//              }
205                flags.remove(flag);
206        }
207        
208        public void advance(float amount) {
209                List<AIFlags> remove = new ArrayList<AIFlags>();
210                for (AIFlags flag : flags.keySet()) {
211                        FlagData data = flags.get(flag);
212                        data.elapsed += amount;
213                        //if (data.elapsed > FLAG_DURATION && data.elapsed > data.durationOverride) {
214                        if ((data.durationOverride <= 0 && data.elapsed > FLAG_DURATION) ||
215                                        (data.durationOverride > 0 && data.elapsed > data.durationOverride)) {
216                                remove.add(flag);
217                        }
218                }
219                for (AIFlags flag : remove) {
220//                      if (flag == AIFlags.BACK_OFF) {
221//                              System.out.println("wefwefwefe");
222//                      }
223                        flags.remove(flag);
224                }
225        }
226        
227        /**
228         * Checks whether a specific AI flag is set.
229         * This is how different ship AI modules communicate with each other, when they need to.
230         * @param flag
231         * @return
232         */
233        public boolean hasFlag(AIFlags flag) {
234                return flags.containsKey(flag);
235        }
236}
